newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish 1998 power prices to fall more than 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spanish 1998 power prices to fall more than 2 pct.

text.p: Spanish Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Thursday that the fall in electricity prices in 1998 would exceed the minimum two percent level stipulated in the plan for the industry agreed last December between the government and five electricity companies.
"As things look now, the electric tariff will fall more than two percent on average," Pique told a news conference on Thursday.
"Levels of interest rates are going to permit (a reduction of more than two percent) and it could fall more if we manage to reduce other externalities," he added.
